\NewDocumentEnvironment{panel}{O{} m}{\textbf{#2} #1}{\par}

\begin{panel}[brief, clear]{Heading}
  Body.
\end{panel}

\begin{panel}[first description, second description, third description,
    fourth description]{Heading}
  Body.
\end{panel}

\begin{panel}[first description, second description, third description,
    fourth description]{Heading}
  Body.
\end{panel}

\begin{quote}
  \begin{panel}[first description, {second, nested description},
      third description, fourth description]{Heading}
    First paragraph.

    Second paragraph.
  \end{panel}
\end{quote}

\begin{panel}[first description,% keep this boundary
    second description, third description, fourth description]{Heading}
  Body.
\end{panel}

\begin{panel}[first-description,second-description,third-description,fourth-description]{Heading}
  Body.
\end{panel}

\begin{panel}[
    first description, second description, third description, fourth description
  ]{Heading}
  Body.
\end{panel}

\begin{panel}[%
    first description,
    second description,
    third description,
    fourth description%
  ]{Heading}
  Body.
\end{panel}
